assumptions: One position across all symbols; USD collateral, no FX conversion or collateral haircut.
Current lot, tick, margin and fee rules are applied as a present-day feasibility replay; not point-in-time historical rules.
Slippage includes spread and adverse execution; both scenarios are hypotheses, not calibrated fills.
Hourly last-price stop/target trigger, market exits, adverse tick rounding; same-hour double touch uses stop first.
Funding absolute USD per base unit per hour; historical timestamp treated as start of accrual period, corroborated by ticker capture.
Intrabar exit funding uses full-hour debit or zero credit as a conservative bound, with uncertainty recorded.
Hourly risk-budget stop can tighten but never widen; no promise of a hard actual loss cap.
Missing funding during an evaluation window aborts that run; no zero filling or silent deletion of trades.
Parameters were fixed before first strategy PnL run; all eight variants are reported, without tuning on validation.
